customExercises.name: Legacy Landmine Row (custom)
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a braced neutral back. Pull toward the lower ribs and lower under control, without jerking the torso.
Use a load or variation that allows controlled technique. Exhale during effort and record only the work you perform.
customExercises.mistakes: Rushing repetitions, using momentum, or exceeding a controllable range.
customExercises.safety: Stop for sharp pain. Use a spotter or rack safeties for heavy free-weight lifts. Seek qualified coaching for unfamiliar movements.
